title: What does searching for information cost your company?
subtitle: Enter your own numbers. Everything is calculated in your browser: nothing is stored or sent.
label_people: People who search for internal information
label_people_lawyers: Lawyers who search for internal information
label_hours: Hours per person per week spent searching for documents or information
label_pct: % of that time you think you could get back (optional)
error_notNumber: Enter a number, for example 3 or 3.5.
error_notInteger: Enter a whole number, without decimals or thousands separators.
error_hoursRange: A week has at most 168 hours.
hint: Fill in the first four fields to see the result.
result: Your team spends {hours} hours a year searching for information, about {cost} a year.
result_recoverable: If you got back {pct}% of that time: {hoursRec} hours and {costRec} a year.
note: An estimate based on your own numbers. Not a promise of results.
